title: Cross-Source Map Benchmark for GNSS-Denied UAV Localization
description: Reproducible cross-source (Google vs. Bing) map-matching benchmark and analysis code accompanying the article 'Learned versus Classical Structural Representations for GNSS-Denied UAV Localization by Template Matching: A Cross-Source Map Benchmark and Flight Replay' (submitted to the International Journal of Engineering and Geosciences). Includes spatially blocked query sampling with fixed seeds, the deterministic hard_v1 photometric degradation profile, coarse-to-fine NCC matching, checkpoint screening with SHA-256 cataloguing, epoch sweep tooling and spatial block-bootstrap confidence intervals. Dual-licensed MIT / Apache-2.0.
